summary: Completed testing of 3 new features: Reading time estimates, Comments system with email login, and Newsletter segmentation. All 16 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Reading time calculation (CompactArticleCard.jsx lines 8-14) correctly calculates based on 200 words/minute with minimum 1 minute
Comments system properly implements email verification flow with 6-digit codes and 10-minute expiry
Newsletter preferences correctly stores categories and frequency (daily/weekly/breaking_only) per subscriber
All new endpoints properly validate input and return appropriate HTTP status codes (400 for validation errors, 401 for auth required, 404 for not found)
seed_data_creation: Test subscribers created with random emails for newsletter preference tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three new features fully tested and working: 1) Reading time on article cards shows 'X min' or 'X min read' calculated from content word count (200 words/min). 2) Comments system with email verification - users enter name/email, receive 6-digit code (logged in backend if email fails), verify to get session token stored in localStorage. 3) Newsletter segmentation - subscribers can choose categories (Local News, UK News, Business, Health, Sports, Tech, Science, Entertainment, Education) and frequency (daily/weekly/breaking_only). All APIs tested: POST /api/comments/register, POST /api/comments/verify, GET /api/comments/article/{id}, GET /api/newsletter/categories, PUT /api/newsletter/preferences.

reading_time.details: Reading time displayed on article cards (e.g., '1 min', '2 min', '3 min read'). Calculation: Math.ceil(words / 200) with minimum 1 minute.

comments_section.details: Comments section visible at bottom of article dialog with 'Login to Comment' button. Login form shows name and email inputs.

comments_register_api.details: POST /api/comments/register sends verification code. Validates name length >= 2 chars. Returns success message with email.

comments_verify_api.details: POST /api/comments/verify validates 6-digit code. Creates session token on success. Returns 400 for invalid/expired codes.

comments_article_api.details: GET /api/comments/article/{id} returns comments array with replies nested. Returns empty array for articles with no comments.

newsletter_categories_api.details: GET /api/newsletter/categories returns 9 categories and 3 frequencies (daily, weekly, breaking_only).

newsletter_preferences_api.details: PUT /api/newsletter/preferences updates subscriber categories and frequency. GET /api/newsletter/preferences/{email} retrieves saved preferences.

newsletter_preferences_ui.details: Customize preferences link opens dialog. Step 1: email input. Step 2: category checkboxes and frequency radio buttons with Update Preferences button.
